RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 1, 2003/Sravana 10, 1925 (Saka)

(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean
Development; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel; Youth Affairs and
Sports)
Total number of questions—20
Effect of industrial discharge on
ground water in Hyderabad
*181. SHRI YADLAPATI VEKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Scientists of Acharya N.G.
Ranga Agricultural University, Andhra
Pradesh, have found in a study that
indiscriminate disposal of effluents from
industrial complexes in Hyderabad is
affecting the quality of ground water; and
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to send a team to see the seriousness of
situation and provide assistance in the setting
up of treatment plants?
Loss to Urea manufacturers by new
pricing policy
*182. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are set to unveil
its new pricing policy for urea, phosphatic,
potassic and complex fertilizers aimed at
drastically reducing farm subsidies;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether several urea manufacturing
units are set to lose over Rs. 620 crore
annually from new urea pricing policy that
has been framed by Government; and
(d) if so, to what extent this decision is
likely to help in tightening norms for
complex and other decontrolled fertilizers?
Shortfall in agricultural production
*183. DR. M.N. DAS:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether foodgrain production during
2002-03 was the lowest in the past seven
years;
(b) whether oilseeds output too was the
lowest since the past 13 years;
(c) if so, the extent to which the shortage
is likely to affect the country;
(d) whether the Ministry has assessed
the total output of wheat, coarse grain,
paddy and oilseeds for 2003-04;
(e) whether any contingency plan has
been prepared to meet the shortage; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?

Foreign universities
*184. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what is the number of  foreign
universities that are operating in one way or
the other in India giving details of the
number and the name of country of their
origin; and
(b) what precautions have been taken to
grant approval to such foreign universities
before their entry in India?
Srinagar rail project
*185. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the prestigious Srinagar rail
project is progressing as per schedule;
(b) if so, its status as on date; and
(c) by when the first train is expected to
reach Kashmir?
Siding track from Kribhco to Hajira
*186. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether keeping in view the
Industrial growth of the area around Hajira
Port, Railways accept the need of connecting
Hajira Port to it's hinterland;
(b) whether Railways will consider
extending the siding track of Kribhco up to
Hajira; and
(c) if so, by when this work will be taken
up?
Central assistance for Orissa
*187. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rivers and
drainage system in Orissa are afflicted with
pollution;
(b) whether it is also a fact that for taking
up integrated drainage, sewage and solid
waste management programmes, the State
has sent a proposal for Central assistance;
and
(c) if so, the status of the request made
by the State?
Distribution of forest land among
tribals
*188. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have agreed to
grant forest land in various States for
distribution among tribals;
(b) if so, the facts and details thereof;
(c) whether the forest land identified by
State Governments for the purpose have
been cleared by Government;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the estimated percentage of forest cover
which would be reduced as a result thereof?
VRS in Railways
*189. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRI GAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Railways have announced
any voluntary retirement scheme for its
safety related front line staff; and
(b) if so, the details of the scheme?

Success of Bt. Cotton
1337. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
DR. AKHILESH DAS:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
assessment about the success of BT Cotton
yield with respect to different regions and
cotton producing States;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether a number of strands and sub-
generation of Bt. Cotton seeds have been
developed by farmers in Gujarat and other
States; if so, what steps have been taken to
examine the same, as to their safety,
vulnerability to pests and impact on soil and
environment?
Subsidies to farmers in developed
countries
†1338. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the huge
amount of subsidy being given to the
farmers in the developed countries of the
world is adversely affecting Indian
agriculture products;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether Government have made any
effort in this regard under WTO during the
last years; and
(d) if so, the details of such efforts, when
they were made and the outcome thereof?
Private sector investment in agriculture
1339. SHRI R. KAMRAJ:
SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that private sector
investments are very low in agricultural
sector as compared to other areas;
(b) if so, whether Government have
analysed the reasons for low private sector
investment in agricultural sector; and
(c) what are the actions taken by
Government to increase the rate of private
sector investment in agriculture?

OPP in Andhra Pradesh
1340. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN:
DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Centrally
sponsored oil-seeds production programme
is being implemented in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; alongwith
the salient features of the scheme;
(c) the districts in Andhra Pradesh and
Tamil Nadu where it is implemented; and
(d) how far the programme has
succeeded in the States?
Project for crop diseases
1341. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Indian Council of
Agricultural Research (ICAR) has
formulated a Rs. 40 crore project to develop
an A - Team spread across research institutes
which would focus on solutions to
unconquered crop diseases that destroy 14
crops;
(b) if so, what facilities would be given
to the team Scientists and researchers to
enable them to work in Misson-mode; and
(c) the diseases and crops targetted for
the research mission?
Technology mission for NER
1342. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) duration of technology mission for
the North Eastern Region and the amount
of fund earmarked;
(b) whether work programme under
technology mission would be implemented
through State Government only or N.G.O.
as well; and
(c) how Government will ensure
effective implementation of programme
under the technology mission?
Problems of Agriculturists
1343. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
some of the problems and difficulties
affecting the agriculturists in the country;
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken proposed to be taken
for the amelioration of their conditions
particularly in relation to sluggish flow of
credit to the agricultural sector?
Promotin g less water consuming crops
1344. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
promote agricultural crops based not just
on productivity per hectare but on
productivity per unit of water consumed to
solve the water dispute in the country; and
(b) whether any amount of money has
been earmarked in the tenth five year plan
for the promotion, research and extension
of less water consumption crops in the
country; if so, the details thereof?
Increasing sugarcane cultivation area
1345. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal with

cultivation of sugarcane in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the proposed financial allocation, State-
wise?
